name: laminar-skills
description: Skills built from the book Laminar Software Design, which defines high-quality code as simple to understand and change, correct in behavior, and fast enough for its purpose

plugins.name: laminar
plugins.description: Reviews code against the three qualities of high-quality code in Laminar Software Design: simple to understand and change, correct in behavior, and fast enough for its purpose. A simplicity finding names the cognitive failure a reader meets, a correctness finding names the missing prevention decision or the missing test, and a performance finding names the waste a known alternative avoids. A coding style skill gives the same book's design directions, each with its reason, for any code that is written or changed.
